The Texas Pacific Land deal has arrived after a sharp swing in EagleRock Land’s trading pattern, with a 1-day share price return of 7.7% and a 30-day share price return of 16.3%

news.headline: What Does EagleRock Land (EROK) Merger Deal Mean For Shareholders?
news.summary: Texas Pacific Land Corporation agreed to acquire EagleRock Land (NYSE:EROK) in a merger valued at about US$620 million. The deal will create a new public holding company that will own both Texas Pacific Land Corporation and EagleRock Land.
